propositions: PASS-path reuse synthesizes empty blocking/advisory/coaching/indeterminate lists instead of replaying the stored REVIEW_RESULT sidecar content, losing findings from the last real review
BLOCK-path reuse already correctly replays stored findings with reused notation; PASS-path must conform to this behavior
CLI notation must unmistakably indicate rendered findings are from the last review replayed because plan/code are unchanged, not a fresh LLM run

Stored advisory/coaching/indeterminate and coverage counts must be replayed on PASS reuse when the sidecar matches the current material fingerprint; fail-open to empty lists if sidecar is absent/unreadable/mismatched
Both reuse paths must render recency anchor (verified_at_sha, timestamp) from stored review when present to let readers judge staleness
